code_removal.counting_rule: UTF-8 source/configuration including SVG; exclude README.md, CHANGELOG.md, AUTHORS, LICENSE and .webp. Nonblank/noncomment excludes blank and leading-# lines; docstrings/inline/XML comments count. Patch is transport: count applied source once, plus delivered demo helpers separately.

full_equivalence.comparison: recursive member names, file contents, Unix type and mode, DOS attributes, comments, non-time extra fields, and symlink targets; ignores DOS/extended timestamps, ZIP64 size/offset fields, and compression encoding
